reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Legs fading late in a long run usually means the long run is a touch too fast or too long for where your base is. Slow it down until you could chat, then add distance gradually, around 10 percent a week with a lighter week every fourth. Eating before and during runs over an hour helps too. Tell me your goal race and days a week, and I'll get a plan built."}
